summary: At zero-based step 68, the polymorphed hero drinks an uncursed potion of enlightenment. C opens the full MAGICENLIGHTENMENT menu; JavaScript skips it because do_enlightenment_effect() records insight.c enlightenment as unported when Upolyd. The source owner is insight.c:enlightenment(), with a second polymorph-specific gender mismatch in background_enlightenment() (C uses u.mfemale for the saved hero gender). The C menu is a single page ending in (end); menu paging is not the first cause.

source.branch: MAGICENLIGHTENMENT with ENL_GAMEINPROGRESS while Upolyd is true. The uncursed potion calls do_enlightenment_effect(), which pauses the self-knowledge message, calls enlightenment(), waits on its PICK_NONE menu, then prints the trailing line and exercises Wisdom. The selected source scope is the contiguous enlightenment() and background_enlightenment() family; the existing downstream sections already contain explicit Upolyd branches and must be verified with the full recorded menu.
callers: potion.c:peffect_enlightenment() takes its uncursed branch and calls zap.c:do_enlightenment_effect(); do_enlightenment_effect() pauses the message, calls enlightenment(MAGICENLIGHTENMENT, ENL_GAMEINPROGRESS), then prints the trailing message and exercises Wisdom.

JavaScript route: js/potion.js:peffect_enlightenment() calls js/zap.js:do_enlightenment_effect(); its Upolyd branch calls note_unported('insight.c enlightenment') and bypasses enlightenment() and select_menu().

Other direct C callers are insight.c:doattributes(), potion.c:peffect_hallucination(), fountain.c:drinkfountain(), artifact.c:arti_invoke(), and end.c:disclose(); their existing calls already reach enlightenment().
dependencies: zap.c:do_enlightenment_effect() owns the game-in-progress MAGICENLIGHTENMENT menu call and its message/exercise order; js/zap.js already implements that order but must invoke the callee for Upolyd heroes.

polyself.c initializes the saved hero gender u.mfemale separately from current form state. insight.c:enlightenment() uses it for the title and background_enlightenment() uses it for role/rank; js/polyself.js stores the corresponding state.u.mfemale, while js/insight.js currently uses flags.female in both places.

win/tty/wintty.c:end_menu()/select_menu(PICK_NONE) provide the menu frame and dismissal. The JavaScript windows.select_menu()/tty_menu.js path already renders and accepts this single-page menu; step 68 ends with (end), not a page prompt, so paging is not blocking this case.

evidence: The saved queue entry .cache/v26-giant-enlightenment-queue-entry.json and challenges/evaluations/20261007095608-v26.json identify synthetic/v26/v26-giant-enlightenment, 2 remaining screens in 78 steps, with the first screen mismatch at zero-based step 68: C cell (row 0, column 0) is a space and JavaScript is T; cursor is [38,20,1] in C versus [67,15,1] in JavaScript. RNG matches through the recording, so this is not an RNG-order failure.

The recipe challenges/cases/v26/v26-giant-enlightenment.recipe.session.json uses #polyself to become a hill giant, then quaffs an uncursed potion of enlightenment. In the recording, step 67 shows “You feel self-knowledgeable...--More--”; step 68 is the C menu headed “Wizard the Wizard's attributes:” with the transformed status and hill-giant attributes. Its cursor is at row 20 and the footer is “(end)”, confirming a single page.

nethack-c/upstream/src/insight.c:383-464 implements enlightenment(): it creates a menu for an in-progress game, emits the title and selected sections, then calls end_menu()/select_menu(PICK_NONE). Its title selects u.mfemale when Upolyd (:397-400); there is no C refusal for a polymorphed hero.

nethack-c/upstream/src/insight.c:468-526 likewise uses u.mfemale for the saved role/rank gender and explicitly emits the current polymorphed form. The adjacent existing menu sections contain source-specific Upolyd behavior at :732-763 (monster-form HP and hit dice), :854-892 (hide innate characteristics), :940-968 (transformed status), and :1487 onward (magic attributes).

js/insight.js:1961-1971 throws UnsupportedEnlightenmentError for Upolyd before building any lines, then uses flags.female for the title. js/zap.js:5896-5928 independently detects Upolyd, records note_unported('insight.c enlightenment'), and skips the menu call. js/insight.js:670-680 also uses flags.female for background role/rank, unlike C’s saved-gender branch.

The exact first cause is therefore the intentional JavaScript refusal/skip on the polymorphed branch, before menu rendering. Fix the insight.c enlightenment/background source family and wire js/zap.js to call it; preserve the already implemented downstream menu sections and windows.select_menu(). No paging change is indicated by this case.
